2027-01-08.title: Friday after Denho · Mar Stephanos, the First Martyr
readings: Devoted to the service of the saints
I send you prophets, sages and scribes
2027-01-08.alt: Season of Denho. Name day of Bishop Philipos Mar Stephanos.
2027-01-08.verse: While they were stoning Stephen, he prayed, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.” Then he knelt down and cried out in a loud voice, “Lord, do not hold this sin against them.” When he had said this, he died.
theo: In the days of Denho the Syriac Churches honour Mar Stephanos, the first martyr. After his great speech before the council, “filled with the Holy Spirit, he gazed into heaven and saw the glory of God and Jesus standing at the right hand of God.” What the Baptist saw at the Jordan, the open heavens, Stephen sees at his death. They drag him out and stone him; he prays like his Master: “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit… Lord, do not hold this sin against them.” A young man named Saul stands by, guarding their coats.

Jesus had foretold it: “I send you prophets, sages, and scribes, some of whom you will kill and crucify.” Martyrdom is not failure; it is the Gospel lived to the end. Paul, once Saul, later praises the household of Stephanas, whose name means crown, for devoting themselves “to the service of the saints”. Today is the name day of Bishop Philipos Mar Stephanos; we pray for him and for all who serve. Stephen began as a deacon serving tables and ended with the crown of martyrdom: service and witness are one road.
outline: Ask: could you forgive someone who was hurting you at that very moment?
The household of Stephanas, the deacon's way.
“Lord, do not hold this sin against them.”
live: Pray by name today for someone who has hurt you.
Offer one practical service in your parish this week.
2027-01-08.prayer: Lord Jesus, you stood at the right hand of God to receive your martyr Stephen. Give us his faith to see heaven open, his love to forgive our enemies, and his humility to serve. Bless Bishop Philipos Mar Stephanos on his name day. Amen.
altar: Stephen was a deacon. At every Qurbono the deacon serves at the altar and among the people; service at the altar and service of the poor belong together.

quick: Stephen saw the heavens opened and Jesus standing.
He died forgiving his killers, like Jesus.
He began as a servant and ended as a martyr.
2027-01-08.action: Pray by name today for someone who has hurt you.
2027-01-08.question: Whom do I need to forgive as Stephen forgave?

family.explain: Stephen loved Jesus so much that people threw stones at him. But Stephen looked up and saw Jesus in heaven. He prayed: Lord, forgive them!
family.intention: We pray for Christians who suffer for Jesus.
family.ask: Ask: “Is there someone we need to forgive? Let us pray for them.”

illus: In 1999 Graham Staines and his two young sons were burnt to death in Odisha. His widow Gladys said soon after: I have forgiven the killers, and I have no bitterness. The nation was stunned. A martyr's family showed Stephen's prayer still alive in India.

pm.open: Lord Jesus, you received the spirit of Stephen, your first martyr. Give us his faith, his forgiveness and his love. Amen.
share: He saw the heavens opened (Acts 7:56). Do I look to heaven in my trials?
Lord, do not hold this sin against them (Acts 7:60). Whom must I forgive?
The household of Stephanas devoted themselves to service (1 Corinthians 16:15). How can my family serve the Church?
interc: For persecuted Christians, especially in India.
For deacons and all who serve in the Church.
For Bishop Philipos Mar Stephanos on his name day.
For those who have hurt us, that they may be converted.
For our group, that we may forgive and serve.
pm.close: Father, your servant Stephen saw your glory and forgave his persecutors. Strengthen us to witness and to forgive, and receive us at the end into your glory. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

homily: Dear friends, in the days after Denho the Syriac Churches honour Mar Stephanos, the first martyr. At the Jordan the Baptist saw the heavens open. At his death Stephen sees the same: I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God (Acts 7:56).
Jesus is standing, as if rising to welcome his witness. The council covers their ears and rushes at him. They stone him. A young man named Saul guards their coats.

And Stephen prays as Jesus prayed on the Cross: Lord Jesus, receive my spirit. Then he kneels and cries out: Lord, do not hold this sin against them (Acts 7:59–60). He dies forgiving. Later, that young Saul becomes Paul the Apostle. The martyr's prayer bore fruit.

Jesus had foretold it: I send you prophets, sages, and scribes, some of whom you will kill (Matthew 23:34). Stephen began as a deacon serving tables and ended with the crown of martyrdom. Service and witness are one road.
Today is the name day of Bishop Philipos Mar Stephanos; we pray for him. Let us ask for Stephen's faith to see heaven, his love to forgive, and his humility to serve. Amen.
kids: Children, Stephen loved Jesus very much. Even when people hurt him, he prayed for them. Let us pray for anyone who has hurt us.

intro: Theme: “Lord, do not hold this sin against them.”
Stephen sees heaven open, forgives, and shows that service and witness are one road.

q: As I watched in the night visions, I saw one like a human being coming with the clouds of heaven. And he came to the Ancient One and was presented before him.
But filled with the Holy Spirit, he gazed into heaven and saw the glory of God and Jesus standing at the right hand of God.
points.apply: Look to heaven in prayer in your next trial.

q: Into your hand I commit my spirit; you have redeemed me, O LORD, faithful God.

While they were stoning Stephen, he prayed, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.” Then he knelt down and cried out in a loud voice, “Lord, do not hold this sin against them.” When he had said this, he died.
points.apply: Pray by name for someone who has hurt you.

q: Then I heard the voice of the Lord saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” And I said, “Here am I; send me!”
Now, brothers and sisters, you know that members of the household of Stephanas were the first converts in Achaia, and they have devoted themselves to the service of the saints;
points.apply: Offer one service to the parish this week.

concl: The first martyr shows the whole Christian life: faith, forgiveness, service.
His prayer converted Saul; ours can change hearts too.
2027-01-08.resolve: Forgive one person from the heart this week.
